Create a stylized abandoned supermarket scene as a roofless cutaway with broken front windows and an entrance facing an open forecourt. Arrange two parallel shelf rows inside the shop around a clear central aisle. Put checkouts near the entrance and coolers and freezers along the rear wall. Add sparse groceries on shelves. Group metal storage racks and boxes in a rear corner. Place carts near the entrance, an entrance sign above it, a freestanding sign in the forecourt, and parking stops and cones at the forecourt edges. Surround the site with scattered trash, tires, grass, and small trees under daylight.
